natural_body: SMB 40% discounts lifted acquisition and near-term revenue but cut retention 12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation is down 6% QoQ. Memory_86 and memory_31 both document that simplified onboarding (fewer fields, shorter flows) lifted early adoption and first-week activation. These are the most directly relevant to the current metrics decline. Memory_91 adds supporting evidence that activation messaging also improved engagement. Simplifying onboarding addresses both measured declines simultaneously without the retention risk flagged in memory_73 (aggressive discounting). This preserves long-term revenue quality by improving product adoption rather than purchasing behavior. Verification of memory_86 and memory_31 will confirm the magnitude and durability of their effects before committing to scale. The referral_incentive and enterprise_sales_assist options are lower-priority given current activation/onboarding headwinds, and promotional_pricing carries demonstrated retention risk that conflicts with the primary objective.
